$comment: State-theme runs that are measured but cannot currently reach the <=3% gate,
each with the reason it is blocked and the row that owns it. This file is a
ratchet, not an excuse list: `gate.mjs` fails on any failure NOT listed here,
and equally on any entry here that has started passing, so the list can only
shrink. Every entry must also appear in the MX-VIS register in

gaps.MX-VIS-036--light: Kit self-contradiction: SubdeckList.jsx renders crumbs + FilterRow + list, the shot draws a DECKS section and no filter chips. Owner ruling 2026-07-25 — JSX is the source of truth; parked until the shot is regenerated.
gaps.MX-VIS-037--light: Same kit self-contradiction, loading branch: the shot is a skeleton of chrome the JSX never renders.
gaps.MX-VIS-057--dark: The shot embeds an additional-translation row and tag content the journey does not create. Light passes at 1.72% from the identical widget tree (dark 4.32%); dark costs ~3x more because light-on-dark glyph edges carry larger per-pixel deltas.
gaps.MX-VIS-063--dark: Match tile tones do not follow the kit's `Tile.jsx` TONE map. The kit tints: selected = `primary-soft`, correct = `success-soft`, wrong = `error-soft`, each with a matching emphasis border — and a *matched* tile is `visibility: hidden`, it leaves the board. This build paints `MxCardVariant.primary`, a solid brand fill: sampled (34,31,53) against the kit's (237,237,239) on the same tile. Invisible until 2026-07-26, because selecting a meaning did nothing at all; fixing that made the divergence render and therefore measurable.
